intent_contract.text: 이번엔 노출도 있는 의상으로 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

Independently define a random, visually complex, photorealistic and non-explicit revealing-fashion editorial scene for a later prompt, render, and visible-reflection test. The scene centers one unmistakably adult woman and one inspectable physical action, while the precise garment construction and exposure topology remain open for a later style decision.

Create a photorealistic fashion-editorial photograph inside a historic mountain hydroelectric turbine hall with a wet tiled floor, monumental turbine housings, analog pressure gauges, overhead gantries, and a grated runoff channel. One unmistakably adult woman, about thirty years old, braces herself beside the channel and pulls down on a heavy chain hoist, visibly raising a water-beaded circular inspection hatch from the floor. She wears a non-explicit revealing editorial outfit; opaque fabric visibly covers her breasts and pelvis. The moment shows the chain taut between her hands and the lifting mechanism, runoff spilling from the hatch, and fabric reacting to her effort. Prioritize the readable cause and effect of her action, the unmistakable adult fashion-editorial presentation with clearly opaque breast and pelvic coverage, and photorealistic material detail across wet metal, tile, skin, and fabric. Render the hall as a credible, distinctive real-world industrial location.
